philosophy: Master board is conviction. ECR and ADP are market/timing inputs, not automatic overrides. Positional tiers and tier cliffs drive urgency.
source_snapshot: FantasyPros fresh Aug 29 expert consensus / Derek Brown / Andrew Erickson / Pat Fitzmaurice
Yahoo Fantasy / Justin Boone Aug 28-29 rankings and ADP movement
ESPN Aug 28-29 composite PPR rankings, depth charts, injury and preseason buzz
Fantasy Life Aug 29 late-round RB analysis
Raiders official camp and preseason usage reporting

material_board_actions.reason: Formal misdemeanor charges plus an active NFL review create suspension uncertainty; Green Bay has publicly said it expects him to remain on the roster, so this is not a talent downgrade or a confirmed suspension. Groin issue adds secondary risk.
material_board_actions.draft_window: CAN WAIT at old third-round price; TAKE only after a meaningful discount
material_board_actions.confidence: high on risk increase, medium on exact rank

material_board_actions.reason: Minnesota officially named Murray the Week 1 starter. Kevin O'Connell scheme, Justin Jefferson/Jordan Addison/T.J. Hockenson and Murray's rushing history restore late-QB1 upside, but 1QB replacement value keeps him late.
material_board_actions.draft_window: TAKE as a late QB target after pick 95; DO NOT LET PAST TURN if still available around 110+

material_board_actions.reason: With Ashton Jeanty sidelined, Washington took exclusive first-team work, flashed as a receiver, then started the preseason finale. Raiders reporting and Fantasy Life both identify him as the clear next-man-up.
material_board_actions.draft_window: TAKE in the 9th-11th if Jeanty uncertainty persists; DO NOT LET PAST TURN for Jeanty managers
material_board_actions.confidence: high on role, medium on short-term duration

material_board_actions.reason: Packers are preparing for the possibility of a Josh Jacobs suspension. Lloyd has stayed healthy this summer and handled 5 of 7 snaps on the first starter drive in a recent preseason game.
material_board_actions.draft_window: TAKE as late contingent RB upside; stronger if drafting Jacobs

material_board_actions.reason: Hamstring injury is expected to cost roughly two months and short-term IR is possible. His prior camp role and draft capital preserve upside, but he is not a normal redraft target in shallow formats.
material_board_actions.draft_window: CAN WAIT; only draft late if bench/IR structure supports a stash

material_board_actions.reason: Boston Globe reporting says Henderson should be good to go for Week 1. Rhamondre Stevenson is still expected to open as the clearer lead back, so role risk remains.
material_board_actions.draft_window: TAKE only at board value; do not chase the injury dip too aggressively

material_board_actions.reason: Raiders say he is still on the mend while also saying they are counting on him for the opener. No confirmed long-term injury, but Week 1 workload remains uncertain.
material_board_actions.draft_window: AVOID AT PRICE in the middle of Round 2; TAKE if he falls into our late-2nd/early-3rd conviction window

material_board_actions.reason: Andy Reid attributed ankle swelling to footwear and said Walker will be OK. No evidence warrants a meaningful downgrade.
material_board_actions.draft_window: TAKE in our normal premium-RB window

material_board_actions.reason: Recent knee hyperextension remains described as minor and Chase publicly downplayed it. No credible evidence currently supports moving him out of the elite first-pick cluster.

tier_notes: RB urgency increases materially after the Jacobs/Etienne/Javonte/Love/Breece cluster; do not let market ADP alone push us past a tier cliff.
Late-RB contingent-value tier now explicitly includes Mike Washington Jr. and MarShawn Lloyd.
Kyler Murray joins the late-QB value tier and strengthens the case for waiting on QB in 1QB builds.
Jordyn Tyson is no longer treated as a normal mid-round WR; only an IR/bench stash.
No change to the elite WR/TE core from today's evidence.
